name: Post Templates
description: Auto-load synced block patterns when creating posts of configured CPTs, plus optional per-taxonomy archive templates.

settings.label: CPT / taxonomy pairs
settings.description: Each row wires one custom post type to a taxonomy. Post Templates registers synced-pattern categories for the pair, surfaces the picker on the taxonomy term edit screen, and (for posts of the CPT) prompts the editor modal when a new post still has the placeholder block. Themes can add more pairs in code via the `orbitools/post_templates/configs` filter — UI rows + filter rows are merged.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.description: Human-facing singular name (e.g. "Resource"). Used in column headers, the editor modal title, and pattern category names.

sub_fields.label: Post type
sub_fields.description: The custom post type this pairing applies to.

sub_fields.label: Taxonomy
sub_fields.description: The taxonomy whose terms map to template patterns.
